title: Acquirer: Smorgon Steel Pty Ltd; Target: Albion Steel Pty Limited

body_sections.Summary: The acquisition of Albion Steel by Smorgon Steel.
body_sections.Market definition: The NSW and QLD markets for reinforcing bar and welded mesh products.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The acquisition raises the level of concentration in the relevant markets, however consideration of other merger guideline factors indentify a number of constraints on Smorgon Steel post acquisition.  These constraints include the excess production capacity of several existing players, as well as the ability to import steel feedstock.
